title: Jordan and Talhelm: Economic impacts of sport fishing in Muskegon and Ottawa Counties, October 1981–October 1982
authority: Michigan State University; NOAA-funded study archived by NOAA
geographicScope: Four sampling areas; Grand Haven North Pier in local catch section
fishingMode: Pier; separate ice, bayou, boat and charter sections
summary: Printed p. 32 describes historical seasonal pier targeting. Printed p. 37 explicitly attributes Grand Haven interview/catch statistics to North Pier; 68% of observed catches were perch. Scanned pages 33 and 38 visually verified.
limitations: 1981–1982 evidence, not modern opportunity. North Pier is excluded from current Grand Haven coverage. General regional seasonal narrative cannot establish species timing at South Pier. Historical lake-trout river-run wording is not adopted as a contemporary biological assumption.
